title: Flat local map on a prepared Popescu chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures R to Cbar and R/pi^2 to Cbar. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: P=R[x_1,...,x_n], finitely many f_l, a_k, subsets E_k, coefficients h_{klj}, g_{kl}, and a surjection epsilon:(R/pi^2)[x] to Cbar with the prescribed kernel, smooth charts, conormal and differential bases, normalized coefficients and cleared relations. Put Q=P[z_1,...,z_m], u_l=f_l-pi z_l, p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, D=ULift(Q/(u_l,p_{kl})), and D_0=D/pi D. Let c:Cbar to D_0 be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D_0. Fix a prime q of D_0 and a chart k with c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) outside q. Put qD equal to the inverse image of q in D, and p equal to its contraction to R. Assume R is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and Ann_R(pi)=Ann_R(pi^2). Then the canonical local ring map R_p to D_{qD} [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No smoothness conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Use chart_relations_pi_divisible, inside the existing proved chart_comparison_bijective helper, to write each remaining equation as pi*y. The key equation identities kill its product with pi. The transported annihilator equality therefore kills the equation itself. Vanishing on the defining ideal and the surjectivity of chartMap make its localRingHom bijective. RingHom.Flat.of_bijective makes this comparison map flat.

proof.text: Use chartMap.commutes to identify the contraction of the partial-chart prime with the contraction of qD to R. Install the canonical localized-base algebra structure on the partial-chart local ring and its scalar tower via localRingHom_to_map. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization transports its R-flatness to R_p-flatness. Compose this flat localRingHom with the flat comparison map. localRingHom_comp and chartMap.commutes identify that composite with exactly the canonical map in the unchanged target conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_lift_chart_flat (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (k : Fin d.r) (hk : c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    let qD := PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q
    (Localization.localRingHom (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) qD).asIdeal
      qD.asIdeal (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) rfl).Flat
